description:
The food.gdt dataset is open in Gretl. It contains real household survey data with two variables: 'food_exp' (weekly food expenditure in dollars) and 'income' (weekly income in $100 units) for 40 households.

Compute the correlation matrix between food_exp and income. Use the menu: View > Correlation matrix. In the dialog, select both variables (food_exp and income) and click OK. The results window will show the correlation coefficient between the two variables. Save the correlation output to /home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/correlation_matrix.txt using File > Save to file in the results window.

metadata.data_source: Hill, Griffiths, Lim - Principles of Econometrics 5th ed, household survey data
